tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. chB:B.2↗ prop:multilinear-maps-tensor-isomorphism Prove Proposition B.1. [Hint: In the special case $k = 0, l = 1$, consider the map $\Phi : \text{End}(V) \to T^{(1,1)}(V)$ defined by letting $\Phi A$ be the $(1, 1)$-tensor defined by $\Phi A(\omega , v) = \omega (Av)$. The general case is similar.] \end{exercise}
